name: NILI FOSSAE — graben system

meta.citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 346 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: Concentric graben northeast of Isidis, and the strongest clay-mineral exposure on the planet. Contour walking between fault scarps.

blurb: Concentric graben northeast of Isidis, carrying the strongest clay-mineral signature on the planet. Contour walking between fault scarps.
